items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWER] No, Charlie Bird. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, the other guitar player.

ctx.x: No, the white guy with the club.

Yeah, the other guitar player. So, anyways, this particular night, Tony Bennet comes in with Carter and they come to see the group wherever we play. Tony Bennet would always hire, even in Vegas, he would always hire Harold Land, or guys he grew up with in the orchestra. He loves Harold Land and Clifford Brown. So this guy…(Laughs) we are over at Charlie Birds and he comes with an entourage. He brought everybody in Washington to the club. I said, “Benny, might have a guest tonight. I saw Bull Moose.” He said,…
